name: Desert Wave Ladies Salon Dubai
address: 26 26B St - Al Muraqqabat - Deira - Dubai - United Arab Emirates
owner_description: Experience personalized beauty and exceptional care at Desert Wave Ladies Salon, proudly serving our clients for over 12 years. Our team of skilled and creative beauty professionals is passionate about helping you look and feel your absolute best. With a strong focus on teamwork, attention to detail, and client satisfaction, we go the extra mile to create a welcoming experience and deliver beauty services that exceed your expectations.

reviews.author: Khadijah Warda
reviews.text:
I’ve been a loyal customer of Desert Waves Salon, and I always have a wonderful experience. I especially want to thank Ms. Cheryl, who always does my nails beautifully—I always request her whenever I visit. The salon offers affordable packages with excellent service, making every visit worth it. It can get busy, so there may be a little waiting time, but it’s definitely worth the wait.
Thank you, Desert Waves Salon, for your outstanding service. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: rowena lucaban
reviews.text:

I was also impressed by how fully equipped the salon is. They even have a free snack bar and coffee station! ☕🥐 It honestly saved me because I skipped breakfast and went straight to the salon. I got to pamper myself, enjoy a cup of coffee and a pastry, and leave feeling refreshed and beautiful. 🥰

What an amazing experience! Thank you, Desert Wave, for making my busy day a little more relaxing and special. Highly recommended! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

reviews.author: Catherine Kate Guab
reviews.text:
I wouldn't recommend for pedicure this salon to anyone!

I visited this salon after seeing their promotional advertisement. The place is clean and the prices are affordable, which is why I decided to try it.

Unfortunately, the service quality did not meet expectations. Although I am aware that there could be a waiting time, I did not expect that it will take an hour for the waiting time which made me feel disappointed.

The services felt rushed rather than relaxing. During pedicure, I experienced excruriating pain and visible redness which I address. I am already removing my foot and telling to the staff that it hurts so much. There was no apology from the staff, hence, she blamed my toenail for having such a dry skin that is very hard to remove which was disappointing. Its almost a week after I went there and my toenail is still swelling and having liquid discharge with unpleasant smell. I feel so hurt whenever I will wear shoes for work. The overall approach seemed focused on speed rather than customer comfort.

I hope the management works on improving service quality, customer safety, and giving equal attention to all customers.

reviews.author: Edilyn magbanua
reviews.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Every time I describe the hairstyle I want, she delivers it perfectly—100%! If you’re visiting Desert Wave Salon, definitely request Rissa. You won’t regret it!

Lastly, congratulations to the lovely owner, Mam April, and the manager, Ms. Joan, for running such an organized and peaceful salon. The booking system is smooth, everything is well-managed, and there’s never any chaos. It really shows how much they care about their clients’ experience.

I’m so happy I found this salon. Highly recommended—it’s definitely a must-visit! 😊❤️

reviews.author: Carla Aquino
reviews.text:
LI visited Dessert Wave Ladies Beauty Salon today and I can honestly say they exceeded my expectations. I booked their promo for 10 services for only 79 AED, so I honestly thought the quality might be basic—but I was pleasantly surprised!

The whole experience was so relaxing and truly felt like a pamper day. Since there weren’t many clients when I arrived, they were able to attend to me very well and made sure I was comfortable the whole time.

All the staff were very friendly and professional—from the lady who did my shampoo and hot oil treatment, to the one who did my nails, paraffin treatment, facial scrub, and mask, and finally the stylist who gave me my haircut. Everyone did an amazing job and made the experience enjoyable.

I left feeling refreshed, relaxed, and very satisfied with the services. Definitely great value for money and I highly recommend this salon!

reviews.author: Zoe’ Arianna Belicano
reviews.text:
I wouldn’t recommend this salon to anyone.

It wasn’t my first time there, my first experience was actually good, but unfortunately, my second experience was completely different.

I went here for an advance booking because I wanted to book an appointment at 8:00 PM. However, I was told that they only accept clients until 7PM, but they could wait for me until 7:30PM. So I agreed to come at 7:30PM.

I arrived early, around 7:20PM, and waited patiently. I waited for 10, 20, 30 minutes, and eventually more than an hour. I didn’t even eat dinner because I thought I would just have dinner after my appointment since I wasn’t that hungry yet.

After waiting for more than an hour, I finally asked the owner, I believe, how much longer I needed to wait. She simply told me, “May patapos na po,” meaning someone was almost finished. So I went back to my seat and continued waiting.

A couple of minutes later, a therapist called someone named “Jhoey.” No one stood up, so I thought she was calling me and had just mispronounced my name. I approached her, only to find out that she wasn’t calling me at all. At that point, I was already extremely frustrated.

They should have just told me to come at 8:00 PM in the first place if they knew they would not be able to accommodate me at 7:30 PM. I completely understand that they had many clients, but I also believe they should respect the time of the clients who are waiting. I wasted more than an hour simply sitting there with no clear information about when I would actually be accommodated.

I eventually told the receptionist that I wanted to cancel, and she apologized and said okay. I was already very frustrated at that point, and I admit that I banged the door when I left.

I understand that businesses can get busy, and delays can happen. But good customer service is also about communication and managing expectations. If you know you already have too many clients and cannot accommodate another one within the agreed time, please be honest and let the customer know instead of asking them to come and making them wait indefinitely.

Customers have their own time and commitments too. A simple update or an honest estimate of the waiting time would have made a huge difference. Customer service should be about respecting not only the business’s time, but the customer’s time as well.

reviews.author: prettyjolie
reviews.text:
I had a wonderful experience at this ladies-only salon! The salon is clean, neat, and beautifully maintained, creating a relaxing atmosphere from the moment you walk in.

The staff are all friendly, welcoming, and professional. A special thanks to Raj, who is an excellent massage therapist and highly skilled at eyebrow threading. I also highly recommend Lyn for manicure and pedicure, and Rej and Jackie for an amazing Moroccan bath experience.

Receptionists are incredibly sweet and accommodating Joana and the rest of the girls! I loved the complimentary coffee and snacks while waiting.

The prices are very reasonable, especially considering the excellent quality of service. I recommend booking an appointment in advance, as it’s much better than walking in.

Highly recommended if you’re looking for a ladies-only salon with outstanding service!

reviews.author: Sunshine G
reviews.text:
I honestly don't know how this salon is still in business. This is by far the **worst salon in Al Rigga** that I have ever visited.

From the moment I walked in, the receptionist (who seemed to be the owner) was incredibly rude, and unfortunately, the rest of the staff had the same attitude. Not a single person made me feel welcome or valued as a customer.

Yes, their prices are cheap—but their service is even cheaper. The quality of the work, the professionalism, and the customer service were all extremely disappointing. I went to the salon expecting to relax and enjoy some self-care, but instead, I left feeling frustrated, stressed, and completely dissatisfied.

No customer should be treated this way. Saving a few dirhams is not worth receiving terrible service and being treated with disrespect.

**I absolutely do NOT recommend this salon. Never again. There are far better salons in Dubai that actually care about their customers. Save yourself the stress and go somewhere else.**

reviews.text: I am purely satisfied with the services and how staffs were too accommodating and friendly. I came yesterday with my colleague and we had our best day to destress ourselves. reviews.author: Katherine Gatchalian
reviews.text:
I had a wonderful experience at this salon! The staff are incredibly accommodating and make you feel comfortable from the moment you walk in. The owner is very hands-on and truly cares about each client, making sure everyone is well taken care of and completely satisfied with the service.

The ambiance is warm and relaxing, and the Christmas decorations are absolutely beautiful, very welcoming and festive without being overwhelming. They also have snack bar. You can really feel the attention to detail, not just in the decor but in the overall customer experience.

Highly recommended! I’ll definitely be coming back and telling my friends about this place.

reviews.author: Kath Rebultan
reviews.text:
I highly recommend this beauty salon in Al Rigga! The staff are professional, friendly, and the services are excellent. I especially love their gel polish—the quality is amazing. They use nano gel polish, which is definitely worth the price because it lasts beautifully and looks flawless.

A special thank you to Joyce for my manicure and pedicure. She is very skilled, gentle, and pays great attention to detail. I also want to commend the Indian Punjabi lady who did my waxing and facial scrub. She was very gentle, thorough, and made me feel comfortable throughout the service. I’m truly satisfied with the results.

I will definitely come back and would gladly give this salon 5 stars!

The only area for improvement is the waiting time. The salon is very popular, so it can get quite busy. Even with an appointment, there can still be a long wait between services. I hope they can find a way to better manage the schedule so clients can be accommodated more efficiently and the waiting time can be reduced.

Overall, I had a wonderful experience and highly recommend this salon to anyone looking for quality beauty services in Al Rigga.

reviews.author: Zeina Shatila
reviews.text: Reaching here by itself didn't feel right and is in a "weird building". Very crowded and the smell of chemicals will 100% cause you a headache. When I reached there despite this, I was told my hair is too long and they cant do the promo I booked. Altho it stated that hair ypto 16inches is included which is 40cm, which is about the length of my hair. And although i only wanted to trim my hair so it should be done regardless of its length!!!!. The receptionist kept saying neck to shoulder length only, which definitely isn't 40cm unless the hair is curly, which isnt my case. She didnt bother to provide another option to suit me as I said okay thank u bye. So just wasted my day to reach there and leave with a headache.

reviews.author: Catherine Pabustan
reviews.text: This was my second time visiting this branch. My first experience was great, which is why I confidently booked a multi-service package . Hoping to finish early, I booked the earliest available slot and arrived exactly on time.Unfortunately, this visit was highly unacceptable. After completing my Moroccan bath and nail services, I was ready for my scheduled massage at 12:10 PM. I patiently waited until 1:00 PM as the salon grew busier. At 1:30 PM, I asked your staff for an update and was assured that I was "next."Despite this assurance, I was left waiting until 2:30 PM. To make matters worse, I witnessed multiple customers who arrived long after me being taken back for their massages ahead of me. Due to this severe lack of organization and a total wait time of nearly two and a half hours, I ultimately had to cancel my massage and leave.I understand peak hours can be chaotic, but prioritizing later walk-ins or appointments over a client who has been waiting since midday is poor customer service.
